summary: Every legal input occupies at most 17 binary positions, while the remotely accepted implementation performs a fixed sequence of machine-integer operations, leaving no honest runtime scaling range.

workload_bound.source_constraint: n is an integer between 0 and 100000 inclusive

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation performs one right shift, two bitwise AND operations, one subtraction, two comparisons, and fixed Boolean composition; it has no loop, recursion, or input-sized allocation.

The certificate regression exhaustively checks all 100001 legal values against an independent binary-string sliding-window oracle; authored cases cover zero, no pair, exactly one pair, overlapping pairs, separated pairs, and the upper boundary.
